{{Quote|I will make it worth your while. I can pay! My family runs the Kozinarg Trade Guilds&hellip; the wealthiest in the Mid Rim!|[[Esano's sister]], to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]|<ref name="TSH" />}}
The '''Kozinarg Trade Guilds''' was the wealthiest [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] guild in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was run by the family of [[Esano]] and his [[Esano's sister|sister]].
